about: Static bake of the stock G20 Comfort dials (docs/G20SIM-B-structure.md). Regenerate: bake/src/G20/structure/build.py. x, y = panel px of the image's top-left; scale = panel px per image px. 'cond' (B's own flags): engine_on = draw only while rpm > 0; no_cc_message = draw only while ccMessage is null. 'clip' (minis' fills): the fill is drawn only on the empty-end side of the mini needle (see notes).

entries.notes: Opaque panel background: pure black (the owner's colour rule, polish C). The photo's blue-grey there (still fitted, as a node grid, to measure the soft layers against) is the LCD's lit-up black, the cabin light and the camera's haze; half resolution.

Semi-transparent black veil over map.region where the dial faces overlap the map (left and right ends). Alpha = 1 - road contrast(x) / plateau, fitted as two logistic ramps [1.0, 598.13, 53.46, 1.0, 1320.77, 53.46]. Only the roads' attenuation is in it; the map's own darker background fade at its ends is NOT (D's map). Drop or tune it when calibrating with D's map.

Pointer-glow zone (distance < 100 px to the needle, y > 415) masked and continued from the neighbours along the band (weak there).

Opaque grey 'wing' face between the band line and the inner edge E, with E's bevel. Colour tables RGB(s, depth) along the band and along E, one for both dials (their mean: one side's cabin light averages out), outlier bins (the numerals' dark halos) dropped, blurred inside the face (no creases). The lower part (y > 415) is under the pointer glow in every photo: continued from above (weak). Day: the night face times one gain (the day photos show the sky's reflection mid-face).

Level fill (grey gradient + dark scale lines), from its inner border line in; where the photo showed the panel's black it is see-through (polish C). FULL SWEEP: clip it to the side of the fuel needle towards the scale's empty end (bottom). Fuel: seen whole (needle near full in 08/09/14). Oil: only its part below the needle is seen; the rest is the fuel fill's mirror image (symmetric fit).
